title: Bar Zuza
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 6:7, Bar Zuza's tenant farmer deposited a litra of gold in someone’s keeping [literally, “with him”]. Bar Zuza died, and his tenant farmer also died. The case came before Rabbi Yishmael bar Yose, etc.[^1]

notes.text: The checked Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 6:7 paragraph calls the landowner Bar Ziza and expressly says that the tenant deposited the gold with “one other person,” גבי חד בר נש. Hyman’s short quotation has גביה, “with him,” and the Zuza form. The English uses “in someone’s keeping” to avoid identifying the depositary as Bar Zuza. The named witness’s third party and the supplied abbreviated wording remain distinct; no legal ruling is imported.
